Comvi i18n 0.8.0 rebuilds the runtime. `createI18n()` returns an instance that is ready on the next line, ICU plurals and `<tag>` markup are part of every message, and loading, locale detection and the editor hook are options of `createI18n()` instead of `.use()` calls. Every binding is rebuilt on the new core, the in-context editor moves to `@comvi/editor`, and `comvi typegen` writes a new declaration. Ten packages ship at one version.

Every app changes code to upgrade. [Upgrade to 0.8](https://comvi.io/docs/i18n/guides/upgrade-to-v08) walks through it step by step; these notes list what changed, the breaking changes first, each with its 0.7 form and its 0.8 form.

## Before you upgrade

- **There are no aliases.** A 0.7 name that is listed under "Breaking changes" is gone, not deprecated.
- **Three packages get no 0.8 version.** `@comvi/plugin-fetch-loader` is now `@comvi/core/cdn`, `@comvi/plugin-locale-detector` is `@comvi/core/plugins`, and `@comvi/plugin-in-context-editor` is replaced by `@comvi/editor`, which the Comvi browser extension loads. Remove all three from `package.json`.
- **Install `@comvi/core` beside your binding** when the app imports a subpath of it, such as `@comvi/core/cdn`. `@comvi/next` now has `@comvi/core` and `@comvi/react` as peer dependencies: `npm install @comvi/next @comvi/react @comvi/core`.
- **One version everywhere.** `@comvi/core` and every binding in an app must be on the same version. Two copies of `@comvi/core` now throw `two copies of @comvi/core` with both versions, in production too.
- **Regenerate the types.** The 0.8 declaration has another shape, so run `comvi typegen` once, or let `comviTypes()` rewrite the file.
- **A visitor's stored locale is not carried over.** `detect()` reads the `?lang=` query and one name, `comvi_locale`, for both the cookie and the `localStorage` key. The 0.7 detector's defaults were `?lng=`, the `i18n_lang` cookie and the `i18n_locale` key. The `query` and `key` options of `detect()` and `persist()` set the names 0.8 uses.
- **The browser extension must be the release for 0.8.** It drives only a site on `@comvi/core` 0.8 or newer with `plugins: [devtools()]`; on a site with an older Comvi its popup says so and does not offer the editor.
- **Version floors.** `@comvi/next` needs Next.js `^15.5.29 || ^16.4.5` and React 19.3.1 or newer, App Router only. `@comvi/nuxt` needs Node 22.20 or newer.

## Breaking changes: `@comvi/core`

**No `init()`.** The instance is built synchronously. With a loader, the first loads start inside `createI18n()` and `ready` resolves when they have settled.

```diff
 const i18n = createI18n({ locale: "en", messages });
-await i18n.init();
+await i18n.ready; // only when a loader is configured
```

**No `.use()`.** Capabilities are options of `createI18n()`.

```diff
-import { createI18n } from "@comvi/core";
-import { icuCompiler } from "@comvi/core/icu";
-import { cdnLoader } from "@comvi/plugin-fetch-loader";
-import { localeDetector } from "@comvi/plugin-locale-detector";
-import { devtools } from "@comvi/core/devtools";
-
-const i18n = createI18n({ locale: "en", compiler: icuCompiler })
-  .use(cdnLoader({ cdnUrl: "https://cdn.comvi.io/<project-token>" }))
-  .use(localeDetector())
-  .use(devtools());
+import { createI18n } from "@comvi/core";
+import { cdn } from "@comvi/core/cdn";
+import { detect, persist } from "@comvi/core/plugins";
+import { devtools } from "@comvi/core/devtools";
+
+const i18n = createI18n({
+  locale: "en",
+  loader: cdn("https://cdn.comvi.io/<project-token>"),
+  plugins: [detect({ supported: ["en", "uk"] }), persist(), devtools()],
+});
```

- **ICU is always on.** `compiler: icuCompiler` and the import of `@comvi/core/tags` are gone: `plural`, `selectordinal`, `select`, `=N`, `offset:`, `#` and `<tag>…</tag>` are read in every message. `{x, number}`, `{x, date}` and `{x, time}` are not part of the syntax: the message renders its key and `onError` receives `syntax`. Format the value with `@comvi/core/format` (or a binding's `useFormat()`) and pass it as a plain `{x}`.
- **A custom loader is the `loader` option**, `(locale, ns, signal) => Promise<catalog>`, in place of `.use(loader(map))` from `@comvi/core/loader`. It returns the catalog itself: for a JSON module, `return module.default`.
- **Subpaths.** Removed: `@comvi/core/loader`, `/icu`, `/rich-text`, `/tags` and `/editor-bridge`. New: `/cdn`, `/format` and `/ssr`. `/plugins` and `/devtools` keep their names with new contents. The `<script>` global build (`ComviCore`) is gone; the package is ESM only.
- **`on(fn)` takes one listener.** It runs on every change the instance publishes and returns the unsubscribe function. The named events of `on(event, fn)` (`localeChanged`, `namespaceLoaded`, `missingKey`, `loadError` and the rest) are gone; a development build throws a `TypeError` when `on()` gets an event name. Problems arrive through the `onError` option as `missing_key`, `missing_param`, `syntax`, `load_failed`, `invalid_locale` or `fallback_used`.
- **`locale` is read-only**, and assigning it throws a `TypeError`. Switch with `await i18n.setLocale("uk")`. It keeps the current locale on screen while the new one loads, and rejects only when no namespace it waited for has a catalog for the new locale.
- **`load(ns)` rejects with the loader's error** when the locale's own load of that namespace failed and no catalog of it is in place. Calling it again is the retry. `ready` never rejects.
- **Namespaces.** The `"ns:key"` spelling is gone: write `t("key", { ns: "shop" })` or `i18n.ns("shop")("key")`.
- **`defaultParams` is gone**, with `setDefaultParams()`. Pass the params to each `t()` call; generated types make every param a message uses required.
- **A plain `{name}` is always text.** A React element, a Vue VNode or a function passed there prints `String(value)`. Markup comes from tags: `Hello, <strong>{name}</strong>!` with a handler or a `components` entry for `strong`.
- **Formatters moved to `@comvi/core/format`** and take the instance first: `formatNumber(i18n, 1234.5)`. `formatRelativeTime` takes `now` as a member of its options.
- **`devtools()` takes no options.** `instanceId`, `exposeGlobal` and `editorVersion` are gone, with the `instanceId` on the instance.
- **`cdn(url, { fallback })`.** A `fallback` entry returns the catalog itself, as a loader does: `en: () => import("./locales/en.json").then((m) => m.default)`.
- **An invalid `locale` option throws a `RangeError`** from `createI18n()`. Match a locale from a URL, cookie or header against your supported locales first; `negotiate()` does it.

## Breaking changes: the bindings

Each binding's README has the full 0.8 setup. In React, Vue, Svelte and Solid, `useI18n(ns?)` returns `t`, `T`, `locale`, `dir`, `isReady`, `isLoading`, `setLocale` and the instance.

- **`@comvi/react`.** `<I18nProvider fallback>` is now `<I18nProvider loading>` (or `suspense`), and it gates the first paint only. `useFormatters()` is `useFormat()` from `@comvi/react/format`. `useI18nInstance`, `useIsLoading`, `useI18nLoader`, `useI18nPlugins` and `useSetLocaleTransition` are gone: `useI18n()` returns the instance and the flags. `<I18nHandover>` hands a server render's catalogs to the browser.
- **`@comvi/vue`.** `createApp(App).use(i18n)` stays, as Vue's own plugin call. `locale` from `useI18n()` is a writable ref, and a failed switch through it is reported to `onError`, never thrown. `<T :components>` renders tags by name.
- **`@comvi/svelte`.** Runes replace stores: `setI18nContext(i18n)` is `setI18n(i18n)`, and `{$t("hi")}` is `{t("hi")}`. `t()` always returns a string; rich text goes through `<T>` with `components` or a snippet named after the tag, and with generated types `t()` refuses a key whose message has tags.
- **`@comvi/solid`.** `<I18nProvider i18n loading?>`; `locale`, `dir`, `isReady` and `isLoading` from `useI18n()` are accessors.
- **`@comvi/next`.** `createNextI18n()` is gone. `createGetI18n({ locales, defaultLocale, timeZone, loader })` from `@comvi/next/server` returns the app's `getI18n()`, with an instance per request, and the server `<I18nProvider>` hands the request's catalogs to Client Components.
- **`@comvi/nuxt`.** The data go to `comvi` in `nuxt.config`, where `timeZone` is now required, and the functions go to `comvi.i18n.ts`, whose default export is `defineI18nOptions(() => ({ loader, onError, missing, plugins }))` in place of the `defineComviI18n()` instance factory. `comvi.icu` is gone with the compiler option.

## Breaking changes: the editor and the tooling

- **In-context editor.** The app no longer installs an editor package or holds an API key. It composes `plugins: [devtools()]`, and the Comvi browser extension loads `@comvi/editor` onto the page. `inContextEditor()`, `inContextEditorPlugin()` and the npm mode are gone. The editor sends no usage context to the platform in this release.
- **`comvi typegen`** writes `interface Catalogs` of the Comvi package your app declares, one member per namespace, with each key's params. New: `--from <dir>` and `--from .comvi/schema.json` generate offline with no key, and `comvi pull` writes that schema file. A `defaultParams` field in `.comvirc.json` is refused.
- **`@comvi/vite-plugin`.** `comviTypes({ translations, output })` is `comviTypes({ from, out })`. `defaultNs` and `strictParams` are gone: namespaces are members of `Catalogs`, and every param is required.
- **An app that declares only `@comvi/next`** is refused by the three generators, because `@comvi/next` has no root module to augment. Install `@comvi/react` and `@comvi/core` beside it, as its install line says.

## New

- **Nested catalogs.** `{ "account": { "greeting": "…" } }` is the key `account.greeting`, the same key as `{ "account.greeting": "…" }`, wherever a catalog is accepted. Nesting groups keys; it creates no namespace.
- **`@comvi/core/cdn`.** `cdn(url, { fallback })` takes bundled catalogs for when the CDN does not answer. `createCatalogStore()` lets the instances of a server process share fetched catalogs, and `api(base, { key })` reads the platform API from a server or a script.
- **`@comvi/core/ssr`.** `handover(i18n)` is what a server render hands the browser: the locale, the time zone, the clock and the catalogs, in the shape `createI18n()` takes.
- **Typed namespace names.** With generated types, `useI18n("acount")`, `i18n.ns("acount")` and their server forms are type errors that list the declared namespaces.
- **An opening tag that is never closed renders as text.** `a<br>b` renders `a<br>b`, where it rendered the key; write `<br/>` for an empty tag. A development build warns, and `comvi check` reports it as an `unclosed tag` warning.
- **`@comvi/next`.** `getAlternates(routing, { locale, href })` returns a page's canonical and hreflang paths for `generateMetadata`; set `metadataBase`, or Next.js leaves them relative. `withComvi({ types })` writes the declaration while `next.config` loads.
- **`@comvi/nuxt`.** `comvi.types` writes the declaration into `.nuxt/types`. It needs Nuxt 3.21.11 or newer, or 4.6.0 or newer.

## Things to know

- **`messages` beside `loader`.** An inline catalog switches off loading for its pair of locale and namespace: with `messages: { en }`, the loader is never called for `en` and `default`, while the other namespaces of `en` and every other locale still load. A `cdn()` `fallback` is a spare for when the CDN does not answer, not a base the CDN lays over.
- **Without a framework, `load(ns)` does not follow a switch.** After `await i18n.setLocale("uk")`, call `await i18n.load(ns)` again. A binding's `useI18n(ns)` does it for you.
- **The limits of this release** are on [Limitations](https://comvi.io/docs/i18n/limitations).

## Speed

Measured with `node scripts/perf.mjs --compare-ref v0.7.1 --repetitions 3` on the 0.8 source (commit `1c73fe09`) against the `v0.7.1` tag, on Node 24.22.1. The command ran twice; each cell is the median of three repetitions, in microseconds per call, 0.7.1 → 0.8:

| Case                                         | First run     | Second run    |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------- |
| `t()` of a static key                        | 0.018 → 0.011 | 0.019 → 0.011 |
| `t()` with `{name}`                          | 0.053 → 0.052 | 0.055 → 0.054 |
| `t()` of an ICU plural                       | 0.394 → 0.354 | 0.416 → 0.356 |
| `t()` of a message with a `<b>` tag          | 0.246 → 0.199 | 0.249 → 0.204 |
| `add()` of one key over a 10,000-key catalog | 2,318 → 1.38  | 2,432 → 1.44  |
| `formatNumber`                               | 0.346 → 0.368 | 0.342 → 0.377 |
| `formatDate`                                 | 0.555 → 0.584 | 0.570 → 0.592 |
| `formatRelativeTime`                         | 0.366 → 0.402 | 0.360 → 0.412 |
| `createI18n()` over a 200-key catalog        | 5.35 → 9.27   | 5.45 → 9.30   |

Two things got slower. The formatters cost 4 % to 14 % more per call. `createI18n()` costs about 70 % more over a 200-key inline catalog, because the instance now checks every catalog it accepts for nested groups, one pass over its keys; the cost grows with the number of keys.
